quizzes.question_text:
Which of the following options have the same value as $5\%$ of $35$?

Choose 3 answers:
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: "Of" in math means multiply. So 5% of 35 means 5% × 35.

5% can be written in several ways. We can convert a percent to a fraction or a decimal: $$\\[1em]$$ As a fraction: 5/100 ("percent" means "out of 100") $$\\[1em]$$ As a simplified fraction: 1/20 (simplify 5/100 by dividing both by 5) $$\\[1em]$$ As a decimal: 0.05 (divide 5 by 100, which moves the decimal point two places to the left)

Put it together: $$\\[1em]$$ 5% of 35 = $\frac{5}{100}$ $\times$ 35 (This matches answer E.) $$\\[1em]$$ 5% of 35 = $\frac{1}{20}$ $\times$ 35 (This matches answer A.) $$\\[1em]$$ 5% of 35 = 0.05 $\times$ 35 (This matches answer B.)
